title: VAEP v3.25 end-to-end flow validation plus N3.4.C read-only cross-review
objective: Validate the complete VAEP v3.25 dispatch path end to end and, in the same unique session, perform a read-only cross-review of the current N3.4.C state at or after base_head. Confirm dispatch receipt, repository access, branch Desarrollo visibility, current HEAD, relevant evidence and gates, then report READY or NOT_READY with concrete findings. Do not take implementation ownership and do not duplicate any ACTIVE owner. If another Jules session is ACTIVE, fail closed and report BUSY/NOT_READY instead of opening a duplicate session.
expected_deliverable: A concise session report containing dispatch id, resolved HEAD, Jules session state, VAEP v3.25 readiness, N3.4.C cross-review findings, blocking gates if any, and final READY/NOT_READY. No repository write is required.
